tools.name: pubmed_search_articles
tools.description: Search PubMed with full query syntax, filters, and date ranges. Returns PMIDs and optional brief summaries. Supports field-specific filters (author, journal, MeSH terms), common filters (language, species, free full text), and pagination via offset for paging through large result sets.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance (default), pub_date (newest first), author, or journal

params.name: query
params.description: PubMed search query (supports full NCBI syntax)

params.name: author
params.description: Filter by author name (e.g. "Smith J")

params.name: offset
params.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based)

params.name: journal
params.description: Filter by journal name

params.name: species
params.description: Filter by species

params.name: language
params.description: Filter by language (e.g. "english")

params.name: dateRange
params.description: Filter by date range. The filter is applied only when both `minDate` and `maxDate` are non-empty; either one empty disables the entire date range.

params.name: meshTerms
params.description: Filter by MeSH terms. Multiple terms are AND'd — all must match.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum results to return

params.name: hasAbstract
params.description: Only include articles with abstracts

params.name: freeFullText
params.description: Only include free full text articles

tools.name: pubmed_fetch_articles
tools.description: Fetch full article metadata by PubMed IDs. Returns detailed article information including abstract, authors, journal, MeSH terms.

params.name: pmids
params.description: PubMed IDs to fetch

params.name: includeMesh
params.description: Include MeSH terms

params.name: includeGrants
params.description: Include grant information

tools.name: pubmed_fetch_fulltext
tools.description: Fetch full-text articles from PubMed Central with structured sections and references. When PMC misses, transparently falls back to Europe PMC `fullTextXML` (structured JATS for records with a PMC counterpart), then to Unpaywall — publisher-hosted or institutional open-access copies as HTML-as-Markdown or PDF-as-text. Provide exactly one of `pmcids` (PMC IDs directly), `pmids` (PubMed IDs, auto-resolved), or `dois` (DOIs, auto-resolved to PMC via the ID Converter; preprints and EPMC-only OA fall

params.name: dois
params.description: DOIs to resolve (e.g. ["10.21203/rs.3.rs-9010375/v1"]). Provide exactly one of `pmcids`, `pmids`, or `dois`. Resolved to a PMCID via the PMC ID Converter and returned as structured JATS when the artic

params.name: pmids
params.description: PubMed IDs. Provide exactly one of `pmcids`, `pmids`, or `dois`. Articles in PMC are returned as structured JATS; articles not in PMC fall through to Europe PMC (when EPMC has a `fullTextXML`), then t

params.name: pmcids
params.description: PMC IDs to fetch (e.g. ["PMC9575052"]). Provide exactly one of `pmcids`, `pmids`, or `dois`. PMC IDs with no retrievable full text fall through to Europe PMC, then to Unpaywall on the DOI the chain re

params.name: sections
params.description: Filter to specific sections by title, case-insensitive (e.g. ["Introduction", "Methods", "Results", "Discussion"]). Applies to `source=pmc` results only.

params.name: maxSections
params.description: Maximum top-level body sections. Applies to `source=pmc` results only.

params.name: includeReferences
params.description: Include reference list. Applies to `source=pmc` results only.

tools.name: pubmed_format_citations
tools.description: Get formatted citations for PubMed articles in one or more formats (apa, mla, bibtex, ris, vancouver). Pass a single format as a string or multiple as an array.

params.name: pmids
params.description: PubMed IDs to cite

params.name: format
params.description: Citation format(s) to generate — single style as a string or multiple as an array. Allowed values: apa, mla, bibtex, ris, vancouver.

tools.name: pubmed_find_related
tools.description: Find articles related to a source article — similar content (similar), articles citing this one (cited_by), or articles this one cites (references). Uses NCBI ELink as the primary source; falls back to Europe PMC then OpenAlex when NCBI is unavailable.

params.name: pmid
params.description: Source PubMed ID

params.name: offset
params.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based); page through results by incrementing by maxResults

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum related articles

params.name: relationship
params.description: Relationship type: similar (content-based), cited_by (articles citing this one), references (articles this one cites)

tools.name: pubmed_spell_check
tools.description: Spell-check a query and get NCBI's suggested correction. Useful for refining search queries.

params.name: query
params.description: PubMed search query to spell-check

tools.name: pubmed_lookup_mesh
tools.description: Search and explore the MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) controlled vocabulary. Returns descriptor records with tree numbers, scope notes, and entry terms, plus pagination via offset for paging past the maxResults cap.

params.name: query
params.description: MeSH descriptor name or free-text term to look up

params.name: offset
params.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based). Pass the `nextOffset` from the previous response to get the following page; the exact-descriptor match is pinned to the first page only.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum results

params.name: includeDetails
params.description: Fetch full MeSH records (scope notes, tree numbers, entry terms)

tools.name: pubmed_lookup_citation
tools.description: Look up PubMed IDs from partial bibliographic citations. Useful when you have a reference (journal, year, volume, page, author) and need the PMID — deterministic citation matching, more reliable than free-text search for structured references. Each citation must include at least journal or year (ECitMatch primary-keys on journal+volume+page; author-only or volume-only inputs guarantee no match); more fields = better match accuracy.

params.name: citations
params.description: Citations to look up. More fields = better match accuracy.

tools.name: pubmed_convert_ids
tools.description: Convert between article identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID). Accepts up to 50 IDs of a single type per request. Only resolves articles indexed in PubMed Central — for articles not in PMC, use pubmed_search_articles instead.

params.name: ids
params.description: Article identifiers to convert. All IDs must be the same type. DOIs: "10.1093/nar/gks1195", PMIDs: "23193287", PMCIDs: "PMC3531190" (the "PMC" prefix is optional — bare digits like "3531190" are also

params.name: idType
params.description: The type of IDs being submitted. Required so the API can unambiguously resolve them.

tools.name: pubmed_europepmc_search
tools.description: Search Europe PMC, a broad open-access biomedical corpus. Surfaces preprints (`source: PPR`), patents (`source: PAT`), Agricola (`source: AGR`), plus everything in PubMed (`MED`) and PMC. Use when additional coverage is needed — preprints and EPMC-only OA records are the typical recovery. Paginate via `cursorMark`. Defaults to `MED`, `PMC`, and `PPR`; pass `sources` to include `PAT` / `AGR`.

params.name: sort
params.description: Optional EPMC sort: `<field> asc|desc`. Documented sortable fields: `P_PDATE_D` (publication date), `CITED` (citation count), `AUTH_FIRST` (first author surname), `PUB_YEAR` (publication year). Exampl

params.name: query
params.description: Europe PMC search query. Supports field tokens like `AUTH:"<name>"`, `JOURNAL:"<title>"`, `TITLE:"<words>"`, `PUB_YEAR:[2020 TO 2024]`, `DOI:"..."`, `EXT_ID:<pmid> AND SRC:MED`, `PMCID:PMC<digits>`. I

params.name: sources
params.description: Filter to specific EPMC sources. Defaults to MED, PMC, PPR when omitted. Pass an explicit array including PAT or AGR to broaden coverage. Allowed values: MED, PMC, PPR, PAT, AGR.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Results per page. Max 100 per EPMC API.

params.name: cursorMark
params.description: Pagination cursor. Use `*` (default) for the first page; pass the previous response's `nextCursorMark` for subsequent pages.

params.name: resultType
params.description: `core` returns abstract, IDs, dates, license; `lite` is a smaller payload with IDs and titles only.

prompts.name: research_plan
prompts.description: Generate a structured research plan outline for a biomedical research project.

resources.name: database-info
resources.description: PubMed database metadata including field list, last update date, and record count.
